basic_profile.bio: I'm a self-taught computer hardware enthusiast from Canada, currently working as an IT consultant. I have a passion for overclocking and vintage tech, often spending late nights tinkering with old hardware to squeeze out every bit of performance. Despite my technical focus, I also enjoy discussing music and cultural topics, especially those relating to indie bands. I’m single and enjoy spending my weekends diving into DIY tech projects or attending live music events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in computer hardware stems from years of hands-on experience, starting from building my first PC in high school. I have no formal education in tech but have learned through forums, online guides, and trial and error. I keep updated with the latest trends and tools by participating in tech-focused subreddits and online communities.
